title: Face Sculpt Contour Group #120 (2인 · 듀오 · 극단 1 + 원래 1 · 브랫츠 돌 + 최극단·볼 패임·높은 광대 그림자 · 정면 · 3:4 세로 · 배경 실내 청록 벨벳 라운지 · 귀 대형 귀걸이 / 철 추)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, vertical portrait-orientation close-up beauty portrait. TWO women standing close together, shoulders touching, each facing the camera straight on in a perfectly frontal portrait, heads level, both ears of every woman clearly visible on either side of her face, framed tightly from the very top of their heads down to the line of their shoulders, the frame cutting off just below them, so the weights and the long earrings fully hang in view. Every face is large and sharp. All of them stand together in one single shared scene, in one row in front of the same continuous background, and this is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, not a collage: the women overlap slightly in depth and the background runs unbroken behind all of them.

#1: A striking adult woman, mid 20s, with the glamorous Y2K 'Bratz' glam look: warm golden-tan skin with real visible pores and a shimmering highlight on the cheekbones, long sleek straight jet-black hair with orange streaks past her shoulders. Her eyes are huge, wide, saucer-shaped almond eyes, extra-large with a big visible iris in vivid emerald-green big-iris contact lenses, both eyes the same, with a round natural pupil and bright catchlights, framed by very bold, thick, long lashes and heavy pink-and-gold shimmer eyeshadow with a sharp winged liner, and thin, high, sharply arched brows. Her lips are extremely plump, big, glossy hot-pink lips with a darker pink lip liner outline and a pronounced cupid's bow, slightly pouting. A small, narrow, upturned nose, high sculpted cheekbones, and a small pointed chin. A sassy, confident, playful look straight into the camera. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living flesh with real pores and fine skin grain and a soft sheen of natural oils, individual hair strands catching the light — a photograph of a real woman's face, not an illustration, not a render.

#1 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about eleven in total (not counting the hanging drops), spread over every area so that no area is empty: a single large septum ring of different sizes and shapes through the thin soft wall between the nostrils, in a short stack that ends above the upper lip; one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; one small ring or stud on the chin; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, the lower opening holding an enormous oval hoop earring almost the size of her palm, thick polished metal set with a continuous line of gems, with a long drop of three graduated teardrop gems hanging freely in the air from its base down to the level of her collarbone and no lower, and the upper opening holding a large classic round hoop earring, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. Henna: fine metallic gold henna mehndi line patterns of vines and dots are painted across the upper forehead near the hairline only, above the forehead studs, well clear of the eyes and brows.

#2: A striking adult Korean woman — Korean poised refined beauty milky ivory-fair complexion with a cool-neutral undertone and real visible pores, mid 30s, sleek black shoulder-length hair with a side part, pushed to the absolute extreme: thick saturated wet-glossy blood-red lips overlined fuller than natural, deep black-brown smoky eyes, dramatic lashes, a sharp contour, vivid glowing amber-gold coloured contact lenses with a vertical slit cat-eye pupil, both eyes the same, fully opaque and solidly saturated across the whole iris with no natural brown showing through, the colour bright and unmistakable, with a darker limbal ring, sitting naturally on the irises and clear of the eyelids, gazing down from beneath lowered lids with the chin raised high as if looking down on a subject kneeling before her, lips sealed in a faint regal curve, an imperious, queenly, commanding expression — a photograph of a real Korean woman's face, not an illustration, not a render. Her whole face, ears and neck are real living skin with visible pores and faint peach-fuzz hairs, slightly asymmetrical with a few small natural beauty marks and freckles, an uneven natural skin tone with a faint flush across the cheeks and around the nostrils, tiny visible pores on the nose and chin and fine natural vertical lines in the lips, never airbrushed and never smooth like plastic, real wet catchlights in the eyes, individual hair strands catching the light. Her face has been surgically sculpted far beyond her natural look, and these changes override her natural features: her lips are the star of her face (the shape, size and projection described here override the lips of her makeup, while the lip colours follow the colour plan stated at the end of this clause, replacing the lip colour of her makeup, and the finish is glossy): the absolute extreme of 'Russian lips', a cartoon-doll mouth made real: the upper lip pressing right up against the base of her nose and the lower lip reaching the very tip of her chin, so the whole mouth is one enormous, glossy, perfectly symmetrical dome and by far the biggest thing on her face; and her eyes are also pushed to the extreme, as a second star of her face: pure fantasy eyes about ten times their natural length and far taller and rounder than normal: the inner corners fully opened with the small pink inner corners visible, the outer corners sweeping across her temples, past her ears and into the hairline, two colossal almond-shaped eyes each with a huge round iris and a clean sweep of white on both sides, symmetrical and graceful, a fine eyeliner in the colour of her makeup ending in a long point swept up above each ear, in very large doll-eye contact lenses with a glossy shine, a round natural pupil and bright catchlights; and her nose is also sculpted to the extreme, a third star of her face: the most extreme surgical nose imaginable: an extremely tall, knife-edged bridge, a long needle-pointed tip projecting far forward and tilted slightly upward, and nostril wings pinched to thin slit-like nostrils; and her facial contour is her own, a fourth star of her face (the contour described here sets the whole outline of her face, meaning the forehead, cheeks, jawline and chin): her hair is swept back behind both ears so the entire outline of her face is clearly visible; deeply sculpted hollow cheeks: below each high, sharply defined cheekbone the cheek falls away in a deep, smooth, shadowed hollow that runs from the ear toward the corner of the mouth, so the cheekbones catch the light as bright ridges above soft dark shadows, and the lower face looks slim, lean and carved with a clearly defined jaw edge; her lips are painted in 2 different flat solid colours with crisp, straight, clean boundaries between them: the upper lip is lavender and the lower lip is deep plum, every block fully opaque and glossy. Every feature is exaggerated but beautiful, balanced and refined, in harmony with the rest of her face, never distorted, never grotesque.

#2 Piercings: A face fully covered with real piercings, about nine in total (not counting the hanging weights), spread over every area so that no area is empty: one small ring wrapping snugly around each nostril wing; on each ear, two separate large healed openings in the earlobe, one below the other with a clear gap of bare skin between them, each opening holding its own very thick, heavy black cast-iron ring as thick as a finger, a plain solid ring with no open tunnel, and above them sit three thick classic round O-rings and studs along the helix rim above the lobe; one small stud across the lower half of the forehead just above the brows in even rows, leaving the upper forehead free; one small stud along each cheekbone, well clear of the eyes. The face and ear jewelry is real mixed yellow gold, silver and rose gold set with glossy multicoloured enamel and rainbow gemstones, while the hanging weights are always black cast iron. Her lips and chin carry no piercing at all, so the shape of her lips stays completely clear and unobstructed.

Ear weights, for the women who wear weights in their lobes: On each ear of every woman who wears weights, all six weights hang from her iron rings in staggered columns, each weight on its own thick chain of heavy links of the same metal as the weight, the chains of different lengths and staggered at different heights so every weight is fully visible and none hides another. Every single weight is a massive, dense, solid, squat, blunt lump of rough, matte, unpolished heavy metal, in the metal named in her own paragraph, at least as big as her whole fist and clearly larger than her earlobe, with no thin parts, no arms and no hollow parts; the last weight is as big and heavy-looking as the first, each chain pulled bar-straight and taut, the long chains hanging freely in the air, clear of the neck and shoulders, with even the longest chain and its weight ending no lower than the level of the collarbones. Because the load is carried by her iron rings, the weight gently pulls each earlobe down a little into a slightly elongated, soft, healthy loop of skin, only a small natural droop that is just enough to show how heavy the weights are; no lobe stretches long, tears or collapses or hangs down to the neck or shoulder, every head stays upright, and the skin stays smooth and intact, fully healed, with no tearing, no wound, no blood and no redness.

Earrings: the large earrings of the women who wear them hang freely in the air down to the level of the collarbone and no lower, and no earring of one woman hangs in front of another woman's face.

All piercings: Each woman wears only the piercings named in her own paragraph, in those places and nowhere else; on every woman the eyes, eyelids and eyebrows stay completely clear. All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar is embedded in the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface; every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden, all of them passing through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around them.

Hair: every woman's hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, jawlines and necks fully visible so every hanging piece is in clear view.

Pose: each woman stands upright, arms relaxed at her sides, heads level, shoulder to shoulder and close enough that their shoulders and upper arms touch or slightly overlap in depth, leaning very slightly toward each other, so that the hanging pieces of one never hang in front of another and each woman's hanging pieces stay in front of her own shoulder. They all share one single continuous background behind them, the same one for all of them, with no separate panels, no split screen, no borders and no different backgrounds behind different women. There is no dividing line between the women, and no different light, colour or background on different women.

Lighting: The background is a dim lounge with deep teal velvet walls and a few soft blurred lamps in muted blue-green, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no other people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than their faces so that their faces and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from their skin tones, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 vertical 8K.
